title: Systematic Discovery of FBXW7-Binding Phosphodegrons Highlights Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinases as Important Regulators of Intracellular Protein Levels.
authors: Singh, Neha; Zeke, Andras; Remenyi, Attila
one_liner_zh: 该文通过降解实验发现FBXW7结合的磷酸化degron基序，涉及转录因子但未聚焦TF-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: A FBXW7 is an F-box E3 ubiquitin-ligase affecting cell growth by controlling protein degradation. Mechanistically, its effect on its substrates depends on the phosphorylation of degron motifs, but the abundance of these phosphodegrons has not been systematically explored. We used a ratiometric protein degradation assay geared towards the identification of FBXW7-binding degron motifs phosphorylated by mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs). Most of the known FBXW7 targets are localized in the nucleus and function as transcription factors. Here, in addition to more transcription affecting factors (ETV5, KLF4, SP5, JAZF1, and ZMIZ1 CAMTA2), we identified phosphodegrons located in proteins involved in chromatin regulation (ARID4B, KMT2E, KMT2D, and KAT6B) or cytoskeletal regulation (MAP2, Myozenin-2, SMTL2, and AKAP11), and some other proteins with miscellaneous functions (EIF4G3, CDT1, and CCAR2). We show that the protein level of full-length ARID4B, ETV5, JAZF1, and ZMIZ1 are affected by different MAPKs since their FBXW7-mediated degradation was diminished in the presence of MAPK-specific inhibitors. Our results suggest that MAPK and FBXW7 partnership plays an important cellular role by directly affecting the level of key regulatory proteins. The data also suggest that the p38alpha-controlled phosphodegron in JAZF1 may be responsible for the pathological regulation of the cancer-related JAZF1-SUZ12 fusion construct implicated in endometrial stromal sarcoma.
abstract_zh: FBXW7是一种F-box E3泛素连接酶，通过控制蛋白质降解影响细胞生长。机制上，其对其底物的作用依赖于degron基序的磷酸化，但这些磷酸化degron的丰度尚未被系统探索。我们采用了一种面向识别由丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPKs）磷酸化的FBXW7结合degron基序的比例型蛋白质降解测定法。大多数已知的FBXW7靶标定位于细胞核并作为转录因子发挥作用。在此，除了更多影响转录的因子（ETV5、KLF4、SP5、JAZF1和ZMIZ1 CAMTA2）外，我们还识别了位于参与染色质调控（ARID4B、KMT2E、KMT2D和KAT6B）或细胞骨架调控（MAP2、Myozenin-2、SMTL2和AKAP11）的蛋白质中的磷酸化degron，以及其他具有多种功能的蛋白质（EIF4G3、CDT1和CCAR2）。我们展示了全长ARID4B、ETV5、JAZF1和ZMIZ1的蛋白质水平受不同MAPKs影响，因为在存在MAPK特异性抑制剂时，它们由FBXW7介导的降解减弱。我们的结果表明，MAPK与FBXW7的协同作用通过直接影响关键调控蛋白的水平在细胞中发挥重要作用。数据还提示，JAZF1中由p38alpha控制的磷酸化degron可能负责与子宫内膜间质肉瘤相关的癌症相关JAZF1-SUZ12融合构建体的病理调控。
